title: Text size basis with an x-height letter and a descender (Hxg)
description: Hxg in Lato Bold at size 20 mm: with T1's H this separates cap height, x-height and descender from the size.

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md, Next 11: line spacing / text-size basis

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (File > New), with Lato Bold (crates/openstitch-design/fonts/Lato-Bold.ttf, OFL) installed for the current Windows user and used as a TrueType font. Add the text Hxg, size 20.0 mm, colour 800 RED, region Fill Stitch at its defaults, line Not Sewn, alignment default. Save As PES (default type) as compat/reference/text/text-size-hg.pes and record in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json the PE-DESIGN version, date, OS, the font as PE lists it, every Text Attributes value and every setting you changed (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
